pitch_headline: A SuperSite backed by 156 reviews and built to work harder after hours.
pitch_body: This version of the SuperSite for Grand Patio Pool is tuned to turn strong review volume into better lead capture when the next call comes in after business hours.
text_line: 156 reviews and no website working hard enough. 30-sec SuperSite demo for Grand Patio Pool.
call_script: Hey, this is Bryan with JAWSAI. Grand Patio Pool has 156 reviews. Real volume - but no system converting the next job when the phone isn't answered. I built a quick SuperSite demo - reviews up front, after-hours lead capture, follow-up. 30 seconds.
section_title: A SuperSite that helps real review volume work harder.
section_copy: When a business already has meaningful review volume, the site should turn that trust into clearer next steps instead of letting it sit passively in search.
